listing.name: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate (WindowSmash)
listing.summary: Experimental AArch64/NEON to C then x64; D3D11/HLSL runtime. Experimental Linux DXVK/Vulkan; Apple Silicon own Metal renderer. Upstream maturity: Experimental; menus/matches and Local Wireless run. Physical pads limited; full two-PC matches/online roster not fully verified; Mac matches untested. Acquisition: Source installer downloads tools/compiler and builds locally. Two alpha release tags have no assets. Platforms: Windows10/11 x64 AVX2/D3D11; experimental Linux source, exact CPU scope not pinned; Apple Silicon macOS14.5+ source with menus only observed. Original data: Own SSBU13.0.5 ONLY, base plus matching update or updated/merged dump; prod.keys/title.keys and firmware NCAs for fonts. XCI/NSP/NCA; expand NSZ/XCZ first. Source data may remain read at runtime. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
